FAQ

How long will it take to see results?

Most users notice improvements in freshness and overall balance within 1-2 weeks of consistent use, but some may experience benefits sooner.

For best results, take 2 gummies daily. Consistent use will help maintain your body’s natural pH balance and promote a fresher scent.

Can I take it with other supplements?

Yes, these gummies are formulated to work alongside most other daily vitamins or supplements. Always consult with a healthcare professional if you have concerns.

Should I use these if I don't have odor issues?

Yes! FloraFresh - Vaginal Probiotics Gummies can be used to maintain freshness and health, even if you don’t currently struggle with odor or imbalance.

Are they vegan and gluten-free?

Yes, FloraFresh - Vaginal Probiotics Gummies are made with vegan, gluten-free, and non-GMO ingredients, so they’re perfect for a variety of dietary preferences!

Are there any side effects?

Our FloraFresh - Vaginal Probiotics Gummies are formulated to work naturally with your body's own microbiome.

Some key points women should know:

  • No disruption of natural pH (our gummies produce the exact same L-lactic acid your healthy bacteria make)
  • No digestive issues (our strain is stomach-friendly)
  • No weird taste (the pineapple enzymes work naturally)

Zero artificial ingredients or harsh chemicals

We recommend taking 2 gummies daily.

Can this product be used if pregnant?

If you're pregnant, it's essential to consult your doctor before using any new supplements, including FloraFresh - Vaginal Probiotics Gummies.

While the ingredients are 100% natural and safe, your doctor will provide personalized advice based on your specific health needs during pregnancy.
